pages.title: Belt Bridge
pages.text: The Belt Bridge allows two belts to cross without interference. Place at the intersection — belts pass over each other seamlessly.$(br2)Essential for building complex belt networks.

pages.title: Splitter
pages.text: The Splitter divides one input into three outputs. Items are distributed round-robin to the three directions.$(br2)Use as a branching node in belt networks for one-to-many distribution.

pages.title: Converger
pages.text: The Converger merges three inputs into one output. Place at belt junctions for many-to-one merging.$(br2)Items from the three inputs alternate through without blocking.
